component.name: LILOPOP Live Captions
component.summary: Translate and caption, live — no connection needed

description.p: LILOPOP shows live captions for whatever your computer is playing or for your microphone, in a small window that stays out of the way.

ul.li: Offline Captions work right after installation in eight languages, with the included speech model; audio never leaves the device.
Offline Translation supports Japanese↔English and Vietnamese↔English with bundled local models.
Online Captions and Online Translation use your own OpenAI API key for English, Japanese, Vietnamese and more.
Select a word or phrase in the captions to see its meaning in context.
Adjustable font, colors, transparency and window size.

description.p: Online features stream audio or selected text to OpenAI only while you use them, and API charges may apply to your OpenAI account. LILOPOP has no telemetry.
Online captions, real-time translation, vocabulary explanations, secure API key storage and persistent appearance settings.
